scope: Evidence-based research notes only. No DarwinG60 drivers are implemented or hardware-validated.

drivers.name: Display and touchscreen
drivers.scope: Panel output, display modes, touch input and gesture events.
drivers.hardware: Archived hanoip kernel DTS names a Tianma/ILI7807S display configuration at 1080x2460 with 60/120 Hz modes. Touch DTS uses compatible tchip,ilitek on SPI. Exact LCD module SKU and exact ILITEK controller IC remain unknown. Android gesture configuration references an NVT-labelled sysfs node, but this user-space name does not prove the physical controller vendor; it conflicts with the kernel DTS ILITEK SPI binding and remains unresolved.
drivers.darwing60_implementation: Host-side synthetic display/touch interface prototype only; no physical display or touch driver.
evidence: S2: https://github.com/bhawesh2002/android_device_motorola_hanoip (Android touch gesture HAL and BoardConfig)
Host-side prototype: src/darwing60/display_touch.py; synthetic test fixture only.
gaps: Confirm the exact LCD module SKU/revision; the DTS panel label identifies a Tianma/ILI7807S configuration, not necessarily the glass/module part number.
Confirm whether the archived kernel DTS applies to the exact Moto G60 regional and board revision being targeted.

Resolve discrepancy: kernel DTS declares tchip,ilitek on SPI, while Android gesture code and BoardConfig use an NVT-labelled sysfs path; the user-space path is not sufficient to identify the physical controller vendor.
Identify exact touch IC model/revision and resolve whether the ILITEK DTS binding and NVT-labelled Android gesture interface refer to different revisions, branches, aliases, or stale configuration.
Verify touch firmware provenance/licensing and required runtime interfaces before considering any reuse.
No physical hardware validation or DarwinG60 kernel driver.
